map.Wells 肺栓塞评分 = DVT 临床体征(3) + 其他诊断可能性低于 PE: Wells PE score = DVT clinical signs (3) + alternative diagnosis less likely than PE (3) + heart rate >100 (1.5) + immobilization / recent surgery (1.5) + previous VTE (1.5) + hemoptysis (1) + malignancy (1); <=1 low risk (about 1.3%), <=6 moderate (about 16.2%), >6 high (about 37.5%).
map.DVT 临床体征(下肢肿胀压痛): DVT clinical signs (leg swelling and tenderness)
map.其他诊断可能性低于PE: Alternative diagnosis less likely than PE
map.制动≥3天或近4周手术: Immobilization >=3 days or surgery within 4 weeks
map.首选高敏D-二聚体，阴性可排除: High-sensitivity D-dimer first; negative excludes PE
map.提示：血流动力学不稳定者(休克/低血压)按高危PE处理，首选床旁超声/急诊CTP: Note: hemodynamically unstable patients (shock / hypotension) are managed as high-risk PE: bedside ultrasound / emergency CTPA first, thrombolysis if needed. Wells two-tier: <=4 'PE unlikely', >4 'PE likely'. Age-adjusted D-dimer threshold (age x 10 ug/L, >50 years) improves exclusion in the elderly. Clinical reference only.

map.无 DVT 症状但 D-二聚体高、心率快等→总分 4–6 中可能，查 CTPA。: No DVT signs but high D-dimer, fast heart rate etc. -> total 4-6 moderate probability; do CTPA.
map.≤4 且 D-二聚体阴性→可排除，不必影像。: <=4 with negative D-dimer -> PE excluded, no imaging needed.
map.同属 Wells PE 评分，本工具为临床决策版；总分>6 高可能直接影像。: Both are the Wells PE score; this tool is the clinical-decision version; total >6 means high probability and imaging directly.
map.活动性肿瘤、近期手术均计入加分项，提高先验概率。: Active cancer and recent surgery are scoring items that raise the prior probability.
